assertions.name: framework documented + prerequisite witnesses checked
assertions.source: This is a deferred-compute framework, not a production extraction. The H_{12} extract itself is queued as a follow-on PR per docs/coordination/2026-05-20-lambda-p-followons-ledger.md §Next-direction recommendations.

description: Framework / next-step scaffold for the H_{12} ⁴He A-operator extract — extending prop:mass-tower-operator-valued from A = 3 (PROVED, this branch) to A = 4 (OPEN). Documents the iterated 3-interface formula, verifies prerequisite H_6 + H_9 witnesses, and records the deferred H_{12} extraction plan.

prerequisite_witnesses.required_for: step 1: H_6 → H_9 reduction (single A-operator extract)
step 2: H_9 → H_12 reduction (nn interface for ⁴He = pp·pn·nn)

prerequisite_witnesses.scope: Direct χ^λ at H_9 for tritium (A = 3 PROVED)
prerequisite_witnesses.required_for: A = 3 baseline; pattern to replicate at A = 4

prerequisite_witnesses.scope: ³He branching at H_9 (A = 3 multi-isotope PROVED)
prerequisite_witnesses.required_for: A = 3 cross-check; H_9 LR sub-blocks structure

deferred_compute_plan.scope: Extract A^λ_{ξν''}(I_nn) for all λ ⊢ 12 and (ξ ⊢ 9, ν'' ⊢ 3) tuples.
compute_steps: Build Hoefsmit seminormal sigmas at H_{12} for all 77 partitions of 12 via numpy-Hoefsmit (hoefsmit_matrices_numpy in rho_k_h3a_refinement.py or equivalent). Max dim 462 at λ = [4,4,4].
For each λ, compute ρ_λ(I_nn) — the action of the averaged half-sum (σ_8 - h/2 · 𝟙) on the H_{12} seminormal rep.
Generate ≥ 3500 test words β_inner ∈ H_9 × β_outer ∈ H_3 (per nucleon: proton or neutron canonical intra-braid; H_9 outer = β_p · I_pp · β_p or β_p · I_pn · β_n etc.).
For each (λ, ξ, ν'') tuple, evaluate Path A (direct χ^λ via H_{12} Hoefsmit) and Path B (iterated formula using H_6 / H_9 extracts) on each test word.

Solve the over-determined bilinear system A^λ_{ξν''}(I_nn) · X = Y for the A-operator matrix elements. Verify rank-full extraction (non-degenerate; existing H_9 extracts showed rank-deficiency for some λ which limits this).
Emit witness with extracted A^λ_{ξν''}(I_nn) matrices + Path-A-vs-Path-B max relative residual.
deferred_compute_plan.estimated_compute: 30-60 min via numpy-Hoefsmit (per docs/audits/2026-05-19-cocasimir-compute-bottleneck.md). Per-partition cost scales as dim_λ² × #crossings; λ = [4,4,4] at dim 462 dominates.
open_questions: Rank-deficiency at H_9 extraction (per docs/audits/2026-05-18-recursive-rho-xi-blocked-by-underdetermined-extracts.md) was 42% error on tritium direct-eval; the same pattern likely amplifies at H_{12}. Closure path: regenerate H_{12} extracts with ≥3500 test words spanning the full Wedderburn-block lattice (not just the 'natural' canonical-form basis).

Alternative closure (not requiring full A-operator extraction): use markov_peel.tr_M_atomic(2, 2) directly to get |tr_M(β_⁴He, q_0)| (already in canonical-mass-table-extended.witness.json at 0.0553483459). The operator-valued formula's VALUE-ADD over direct markov_peel is structural transparency (per-(μ_1,...,μ_A)-block decomposition), not numerical precision.
